items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I had in the band a great personnel with Charlie Parker as one of my side men.

ctx.x: Right. Well, had you -- I mean, how much recording had you done by then?

Well, by that time then I had already -- I more or less had established myself in the recording field of jazz, with some recordings that I'd done previous to all of these things with Apollo Records. I made my first recordings on my own, with Apollo Record Company. I think this was about 1944, and I made some great arrangements and some great tunes, and recordings, and I had in the band a great personnel with Charlie Parker as one of my side men. Charlie Parker was on alto saxophone, and Dexter Gordon was on tenor…
